gloss: to lose consciousness; to black out

definitions.gloss: to lose consciousness; to black out; to faint
definitions.explanation: To gradually lose awareness, as if consciousness is receding into the distance. Describes the experience of fainting, passing out, or drifting into unconsciousness.

examples.japanese: {意識|いしき}が{遠|とお}のいていった。
{痛|いた}みで{意識|いしき}が{遠|とお}のきそうになった。
examples.english: I almost blacked out from the pain.

examples.japanese: {熱中症|ねっちゅうしょう}で{意識|いしき}が{遠|とお}のき、{気|き}がついたら{病院|びょういん}にいた。
examples.english: I lost consciousness from heatstroke and when I came to, I was in the hospital.

notes:
USAGE:
A vivid expression that describes consciousness moving away ({遠|とお}のく = to recede, to move far away). It captures the gradual, drifting quality of losing awareness, unlike the more abrupt {気|き}を{失|うしな}う. Often used in narrative or first-person accounts of medical emergencies, exhaustion, or intense pain.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {意識|いしき}が{遠|とお}のいていく (consciousness fading away — progressive form)
- {意識|いしき}が{遠|とお}のきそうになる (to feel like one is about to lose consciousness)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {気|き}を{失|うしな}う: to lose consciousness — more clinical and abrupt
- {意識|いしき}を{失|うしな}う: to lose consciousness — neutral, medical term
- {気絶|きぜつ}する: to faint — more sudden, often from shock
